advanced-filter-description: Mɔɖeɖe ŋgɔyiyi na mɔ be woaŋlɔ fli si me dɔwɔnadzesi siawo le: == != <= >= && || ( ) Wozã teƒe gbɔlo be woama dɔwɔnadzesiwo dome. Àte ŋu amɔ agble tɔxɛwo katã to woƒe ŋkɔwo kple asixɔxɔwo ŋɔŋlɔ dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == Value1. Dzesi: Ne teƒe gbɔlo le agblewo alo asixɔxɔwo me la, ele be nàtsɔ wo ade kaklã ɖeka me. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Be woatsɔ asi adzo le dziɖudzesi ɖeka (' \/) ŋu la, àte ŋu azã \. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == I\'m. Àte ŋu atsɔ nɔnɔme geɖewo afli ɖekae hã. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Zi geɖe la, woɖea dɔwɔnadzesiwo katã me tso miame yi nuɖusime. Àte ŋu atrɔ̃ ɖoɖo la to kaklãwo deɖe me dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Àte ŋu adi nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe agblewo hã to regex zazã me: F1 == /Tes.*/i

Vodada siwo anɔ anyi tegbee kple gbedeasi siwo va ɖo agbagbadzedze ƒe seɖoƒe la anɔ anyi na numetoto. Agbagbadzedze ake le gbedeasi siwo medze edzi o ŋu dzea agbagbadzedze yeye gɔme eye wòléa tete vie si li xoxo la ɖe asi.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Wrike ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔ nye nɔnɔmewo ƒe xexlẽdzesi, ɖesiaɖe le Active, Completed, Deferred alo Cancelled ƒuƒoƒo me. Ðeɖe ŋlɔa kpekpeɖeŋu sia ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo abe ɖeka ene, si woyɔ ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu la ŋkɔ, le JSON si Wrike ƒe API trɔna ɖoa na dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔwo me: wɔ dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔ ma le Wrike me hafi nàtsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu la ƒe Wrike Excel ɖeɖe va eme, ale be woazã eƒe nɔnɔmewo. Nuxɔxɔ xlẽa JSON ma si nètsɔ de etame, tso WeKan alo tso Wrike ƒe GET /workflows, ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu si wotia me: nɔnɔme si si xexlẽdzesi mele o la zua xexlẽdzesi, eye se aɖe dea dzesi kaɖi be wowu enu ne wotsɔe yi Completed alo Cancelled nɔnɔme me eye be mewu enu o le Active alo Deferred me. Womate ŋu aɖe Wrike ŋutɔ ƒe automation sewo tso Wrike o.
